nodes.label: World model as an internal simulator
nodes.source_location: PDF pages 4-5, 12-13; Executive Summary and sections 2.1-2.3
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.rationale: Query hypothetical actions before irreversible physical execution; visual plausibility alone is not control evidence.

nodes.label: Pearl causal ladder for physical control
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.limitation: The briefing's general claims about what all text-trained models cannot do are arguments, not experimental proofs of incapability.

nodes.label: POMDP and latent encoder-transition-decoder
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: States, actions, observations, transitions, emissions, rewards and discount; imagined rollouts optimize discounted reward.
nodes.limitation: A formal model definition is not evidence that its learned transitions match a particular robot.

nodes.label: Renderer school of world models
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: The briefing groups Sora, Genie, Oasis and Gen-3 as photorealistic generators with incidentally learned physics.
nodes.limitation: Taxonomy and comparative performance are author assertions; no vendor adoption or independent replication established.

nodes.label: Latent and JEPA predictive school
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Groups V-JEPA, I-JEPA, DreamerV3 and TD-MPC2 around abstract-state prediction.
nodes.limitation: Fewer-than-62-hour and sub-5-ms claims are not verified here and cannot be generalized to every model, task or hardware platform.

nodes.label: Spatial occupancy and engineered physics school
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Explicit metric geometry, occupancy and physical constraints are proposed for industrial validation.
nodes.limitation: Grouping Tesla-style occupancy, Cosmos, Isaac Sim and Genesis does not establish that they share PINN architecture or certified guarantees.

nodes.label: FM1: Compounding autoregressive drift
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Prediction errors accumulate and degrade long-horizon state consistency.
nodes.limitation: The stated O(T epsilon) bound needs assumptions; it is not a universal stability theorem.
nodes.required_evidence: Drift at increasing horizons including hours, not only short demonstrations.

nodes.label: FM2: Executability gap
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Perceptual similarity does not establish feasible contact dynamics or actuator commands.
nodes.required_evidence: Real or validated simulator contact checks, friction assumptions and physical invariants; LPIPS/SSIM alone are insufficient.

nodes.label: FM3: Perceptual hallucination
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: An unfamiliar structure can be mapped into a familiar representation, corrupting the initial state estimate.
nodes.limitation: The nearest-codebook equation describes a mechanism, not every world-model architecture.

nodes.label: FM4: Action marginalization
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Predictions barely change when actions are changed or shuffled, despite plausible output.
nodes.required_evidence: Controlled interventions on action input; seed variation is not a control-response test.

nodes.label: FM5: Sim-to-real reality gap
nodes.source_location: PDF page 17; section 2.13; PDF page 24, section 4.4
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Simulator and real distributions differ through noise, contact and long-tail variability.
nodes.required_evidence: Retain real-world validation and disclose synthetic/real mixture; reject claims of universally eliminating the gap.

nodes.label: Accumulate-and-filter synthetic-data governance
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.rationale: Retain real observations and filter generated samples to reduce recursive replacement and tail loss.
nodes.alpha_definition: Real-data fraction in D_next = alpha D_real + (1-alpha) verified synthetic.
nodes.limitation: The document's 'avoids collapse entirely' wording overgeneralizes conditional research results; a ratio alone does not prove training safety.

nodes.label: PINN loss augmentation for physical invariants
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.rationale: Penalize governing-equation residuals during generation; augment rather than replace certified simulation.
nodes.limitation: A weighted soft residual penalty is not automatically a hard boundary constraint or a proof of physical correctness.

nodes.label: Reconstruction residual diagnostic
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Squared observation reconstruction error flags poorly represented inputs.
nodes.limitation: Proxy only; not a calibrated probability of failure or a pure aleatoric uncertainty decomposition.

nodes.label: Inter-seed denoising variance diagnostic
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Sample variance of seeded predicted latent states, logged separately from reconstruction residual.
nodes.limitation: Low disagreement does not rule out common-mode error; randomness is not automatically epistemic uncertainty.

nodes.label: Telemetry-calibration-generation-deployment-feedback loop
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.rationale: Anchor synthetic generation to observed dynamics and feed uncertainty-flagged outcomes back into calibration.
nodes.limitation: Worked robotic-part example is illustrative, not a measured deployment outcome.

nodes.label: Dataset cards, fingerprints and re-anchoring
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.rationale: Make data governance operational through model version, verifier, measured pass rate, sample provenance, enforced mixture ratio and scheduled real-data refresh.

nodes.label: Seven-axis world-model claim evaluation
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: School fit, long-horizon consistency, executability evidence, collapse governance, uncertainty exposure, sim-to-real honesty and benchmark provenance.
nodes.rationale: Require inspectable evidence per claim rather than trusting attractive demonstrations.

nodes.label: Genesis scaling, adoption and ROI projections
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Text exhaustion in 2027-2028, compute/power limits, adoption economics and synthetic-simulation ROI motivate the thesis.
nodes.limitation: 80% setup, 40% cost and 50% time-to-market reductions lack checkable study details here; unnamed autonomous-driving adoption cannot identify a proprietary vendor integration.

nodes.label: Humanoid Capital Trap market thesis
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Uses $3.2B versus less than $20M and a 160:1 ratio to argue for independent assurance.
nodes.limitation: Company funding, valuation and revenue rows use differing scopes and dates; software-governance valuation analogies do not establish willingness to pay.

nodes.label: Illustrative physical-AI validation TAM
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: 1.5M units in 2032 times $1,500-$2,500 annually yields $2.25B-$3.75B; not an observed market.

nodes.label: Independent V&V commercial thesis
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.rationale: Separate incentives to ship from incentives to verify; consider TIC partnerships, insurers and a ring-fenced platform.
nodes.limitation: Independence does not itself ensure assessor acceptance, exclude OEM competitors or guarantee 30-40% EBIT; software gross margins and services EBIT are different metrics.

nodes.label: Seven proposed patent vectors
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Frechet degradation, provenance ratios, runtime executability, bounded reachability, cross-embodiment, adversarial generation and compliance translation.
nodes.limitation: No filing, grant, novelty determination or freedom-to-operate conclusion is supplied.

nodes.label: Idea 1 regulatory forcing-function claims
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.status: externally unverified legal and standards interpretation
nodes.description: Cites Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, 20 January 2027 and draft ISO/AWI 25785-1.
nodes.limitation: Broad statements that robotics OEMs cannot self-certify and that a draft will require particular ML metrics require exact applicability review; named TIC certification claims are not independently checked.

nodes.label: TIC, OEM and FTO validation milestones
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.rationale: Validate assessor demand and OEM transfer pain, then obtain patent-attorney FTO review before committing capital.

nodes.label: Four-tier research evidence taxonomy
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Source labels Verified, Reported, Estimated and Speculative distinguish primary-source claims, self-reports, estimates and judgments.
nodes.limitation: These are the document's labels, not external verification performed by this extraction.

nodes.label: Physical-AI commercial maturity tiers
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Distinguishes production, bounded customer pilots and laboratory demonstrations; proposes integration, validation, synthetic-data and managed-MLOps services.
nodes.limitation: Examples, contracts, MTBF estimates and company economics remain attributed claims; pilot activity is not unconstrained production deployment.

nodes.label: Continuous action flow matching
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Discusses pi0 and ManiFlow as alternatives to discrete action tokenization; cites pi0 arXiv:2410.24164.
nodes.limitation: Reported 50 Hz trajectories do not establish deterministic deadline compliance on an unspecified deployment.

nodes.label: Brownfield PLC-to-AI integration
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.rationale: Wrap neural outputs with deterministic middleware and hardware interlocks around incumbent PLCs rather than bypassing plant safety systems.
nodes.description: Names Siemens S7-1500, Rockwell ControlLogix, Profinet, EtherCAT and edge Jetson as proposed interfaces.
nodes.limitation: No supplied hardware, adapter conformance results or live integration credentials; named products are not verified platform partners.
nodes.required_extension: Define versioned telemetry/action schemas, units, frames, clock synchronization, watchdogs, disconnect behavior and approved safe-state handling before any live integration.

nodes.label: Jacobian singularities and damped least squares
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Low Yoshikawa manipulability can amplify required joint velocity; motivates singularity-aware inverse kinematics and DLS.
nodes.limitation: Bounds depend on robot geometry and constraints; the document's nearby '15N torque' example is dimensionally wrong because torque requires N m.

nodes.label: Physical-control deadlines and safety interlocks
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.status: stated engineering requirements, not measured performance
nodes.description: At least 50 Hz actuator output, at most 20 ms cycle time, below 1 ms fieldbus jitter, and dual-channel safety architecture are discussed.
nodes.limitation: Timing requirements are application-specific; an offline scorecard cannot establish them.

nodes.label: Proposed CBF and reachability safety dossier
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Control Barrier Functions, a declared safe set and bounded reachable sets using alpha-beta-CROWN support scoped safety claims.
nodes.limitation: R(T;X0) subset C requires validated dynamics, initial-set and disturbance assumptions; neural bounds alone do not certify the full robot or satisfy all ISO 13849/IEC 61508 obligations.

nodes.label: LTTS 2027 phased engineering roadmap
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.rationale: V&V precedes PLC alliances; alliances unlock customer CAD and telemetry before a synthetic-data factory; skills development runs throughout.
nodes.limitation: No approved budget, procurement, lab accreditation or partnership established.

nodes.label: Adversarial removal and downgrade log
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Withdraws precise Ford, Airbus, Amazon, GE, TSMC, Caterpillar, surgical, Symbotic, DHL and Siemens metrics as unsupported, conflated or unaudited.
nodes.limitation: Do not reintroduce withdrawn values as facts or infer proprietary vendor methods from sector descriptions.

nodes.label: Independent physical-AI assurance platform
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.status: proposed broad seven-module platform; prototype asserted
nodes.limitation: Section 5.1 leaves current capability, results, programme count and demonstration details as placeholders; section 5.2 leaves every module maturity as [status].
nodes.rationale: Combine scored evidence, runtime checks, scoped proof, data governance and assessor-facing records rather than equating one metric with safety.

nodes.label: Degradation scorer
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Discrete Frechet base measure between intended and executed end-effector paths.
nodes.limitation: Path geometry is one aspect of transfer, not an exact complete physical gap; commanded-versus-actual recordings are not automatically simulator-versus-robot trials.

nodes.label: Runtime executability guard
nodes.source_location: PDF pages 9-10; section 5.2 and section 6 item 3
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.status: proposed module; not demonstrated in assigned MVP evidence
nodes.description: Checks action chunks against physical invariants and requests a halt on violation.
nodes.limitation: Must define measurable invariants, response latency and embodiment-specific safe state; an immediate power cut can itself endanger a balancing robot.

nodes.label: Bounded-behaviour verifier
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Use Lean 4, Marabou or alpha-beta-CROWN on tractable sub-policies and safety filters.
nodes.limitation: No claim of verifying an entire billion-parameter VLA; timeouts, unsupported operators and unmet assumptions must remain unknown, not safe.

nodes.label: Adversarial scenario engine
nodes.source_location: PDF pages 9-10; section 5.2 and section 6 item 6
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Search lighting, friction and mass parameters for perceptual and contact failures.
nodes.limitation: MVP command/noise disturbance hunts are narrower than a validated physics or perception simulator; finite search cannot prove absence of failure.

nodes.label: Cross-embodiment benchmark
nodes.source_location: PDF pages 9-10; section 5.2 and section 6 item 5
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Measure degradation when a policy transfers to a different kinematic structure.
nodes.limitation: Requires identified policies, real embodiment/task correspondence and physical success criteria; scaled XY replays do not demonstrate zero-shot policy transfer.

nodes.label: Data provenance ledger
nodes.source_location: PDF page 9; section 5.2 and section 6 item 2
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Audit synthetic/real mixture across generation tiers through dataset cards and provenance.
nodes.limitation: A run hash chain does not establish honest source labels, actual training ingestion or immunity to recursive model collapse.

nodes.label: Compliance mapping engine
nodes.source_location: PDF pages 9-11; section 5.2, section 6 item 7, section 7.4
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Map scores, bounds and proofs to applicable risk-assessment requirements while isolating changing standards from core measurements.
nodes.limitation: A generated dossier is not certification; applicability, clause version and assessor acceptance must be established separately.

nodes.label: Layered and evidence-limited assurance claims
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.rationale: Prove tractable components, check runtime behavior and stress the integrated system; limit each claim to demonstrated layers and assumptions.

nodes.label: Unresolved IP filing and freedom-to-operate status
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Drafted [N], Filed [N], Planned [N], novelty list and FTO [status] are unfilled.
nodes.limitation: Cannot infer any filed or granted patents; trade-secret and standards-participation strategy is proposed, not proven protection.

nodes.label: Machinery Regulation and draft humanoid standard mapping
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.status: source explicitly requests legal and standards confirmation
nodes.description: Lists EU 2023/1230 application on 20 January 2027 and ISO/AWI 25785-1 under development.
nodes.limitation: Exact Annex I Part A wording and standard title, scope and stage are marked for confirmation; reported TIC events still contain [cite].

nodes.label: 90-day platform validation protocol
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.description: Days 0-30 reproduce reference results; 30-60 adversarial sweep and evidence pack; 60-90 external assessor/insurer feedback and FTO opinion.
nodes.limitation: Reproducibility within X% and other exit criteria are examples, not agreed or achieved gates.

nodes.label: Independent verification entity and governance firewall
nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya
nodes.rationale: Separate verification evidence from OEM engineering incentives through an information firewall and milestone-gated investment.
nodes.limitation: Independence, premium pricing, target margins and a defensible competitive position require validation; TIC bodies may build or acquire internally.

nodes.label: Transformer attention and inference efficiency
nodes.source_location: PDF pages 8-16, 28-30, 43-48; chapters 2-4, 9, glossary and sources
nodes.description: Self-attention, BPE, positional encoding, MoE, FlashAttention, KV caching, GQA, MLA, quantization and speculative decoding.
nodes.limitation: Generic mechanisms are distinct from unconfirmed proprietary architecture attributions.

nodes.label: Compute allocation and test-time reasoning
nodes.description: Kaplan versus Chinchilla allocation; SFT/RLHF and Constitutional AI; outcome/process verification and inference-time search.
nodes.limitation: MCTS use by proprietary reasoning models is explicitly unconfirmed.

nodes.label: Group Relative Policy Optimization
nodes.source_location: PDF page 18; section 5.3.1; PDF page 47, reference 22
nodes.description: Normalize each sampled candidate reward by its group's mean and standard deviation, avoiding a separate learned critic.
nodes.limitation: Verifier quality and zero reward variance require explicit handling; reasoning rewards do not automatically transfer to physical safety.

nodes.label: Model Context Protocol integration primitives
nodes.source_location: PDF page 19; section 6.2; PDF page 48, reference 30
nodes.description: JSON-RPC tools, resources and prompts decouple enterprise integration from model-provider selection.
nodes.limitation: A protocol is not authorization, real-time control or a working hardware adapter.

nodes.label: Long-horizon context and constraint retention
nodes.rationale: Preserve exact constraints, units and cross-window references across long work sessions.
nodes.status: design concern grounded in the source; vendor mechanism claims unverified
nodes.limitation: Claims of native recurrent state and lossless multi-day vendor context are not established here.
nodes.required_extension: Persist versioned source references, decisions, assumptions and unit contracts explicitly; test reload and provenance rather than trusting model memory.

nodes.label: Least-privilege agent governance
nodes.rationale: Treat uploaded and retrieved content as untrusted; limit tools, isolate tenants, control egress, require approval for consequential actions, and log replayable operations.
nodes.limitation: RAG and confident model output do not establish correctness; ZDR, residency and training exclusion are distinct contractual controls, not inferred from a product name.

nodes.label: Private evaluations and benchmark provenance
nodes.rationale: Use private representative tasks, known outcomes and matched harnesses; distinguish self-report, independent measurement, contamination and task-completion reliability.
nodes.limitation: A 50% task-completion horizon is not a production safety guarantee; even a private set needs leakage controls.

nodes.label: Exercised open-weight fallback and verified distillation
nodes.rationale: Maintain a tested fallback for continuity/residency-sensitive work and verify teacher outputs before narrow-task distillation.
nodes.limitation: Self-hosting has licensing, security, utilization and validation costs; no failover was deployed in this extraction.

nodes.label: Unverified September 2026 frontier-model narrative
nodes.status: externally unverified source claims, including claims labelled Verified
nodes.description: Document asserts GPT-6 Astra, Fable/Mythos 5.1, other named model releases, exact pricing, benchmark rankings, restricted partner tiers and a June 2026 export-control suspension.
nodes.limitation: Do not treat these model identities, URLs, specifications, chronology or vendor internals as independently established facts or use them as procurement requirements without primary-source checking.

nodes.label: Genuity Verify Module-1 prototype
nodes.source_location: Opening, demo script, Layout, Honesty labels
nodes.status: documented prototype, not executed during extraction
nodes.description: Offline scorecards, deterministic fixtures, sweeps, provenance ledger and draft dossier workflow.
nodes.limitation: Synthetic demonstrations and DRAFT gates cannot authorize deployment; jerk/bounds are explicitly proxies.

nodes.label: MVP documented acceptance suite
nodes.description: README lists ten tests for discrimination, zero sensitivity, fail-closed behavior, determinism, tamper evidence, dependency scan and local API.
nodes.limitation: Older technical/procedural documents still say five tests; test count and actual coverage require code-level validation outside this chunk.

nodes.label: Python 3.10+ zero-dependency prototype
nodes.rationale: Keep the demo offline and installation-free; future NumPy/OXE tooling belongs in a separate backend-ml layer.
nodes.limitation: This is the original prototype constraint, not proof that future simulation or formal verification can be implemented dependency-free.

nodes.label: Paired trajectory schema and units
nodes.description: pair.json carries id, T, dt, fields, frame, sim and real; card.json carries provenance and parameters.
nodes.units: Synthetic: abstract 2D workspace, bounds +/-2, dt 0.05 s, T usually 200 or 400. Real/morph: meters in Franka base frame at native rate; dt not asserted.
nodes.limitation: Do not apply abstract-unit thresholds to meters without calibration; preserve timing and frames before derivative or cross-source comparisons.

nodes.label: 45 deterministic synthetic trajectory pairs
nodes.status: corpus described by README; raw files not independently audited in this chunk
nodes.description: 15 scenarios times three seeds; reaches, pick/place, wipe, insertion, curves, hesitation, dropout, bias, latency, speed, contact slide and long horizon.
nodes.limitation: The field named real is generated with bias, noise, dropout, lag and contact-stick distortions; its name does not make it a real capture.

nodes.label: Five DROID Franka pour captures
nodes.status: documented public real recordings; availability not independently rechecked here
nodes.description: Five success episodes from BAIR/AUTOLab 2023-07-07 pour session, described as Franka FR3. Commanded EE XY is stored as sim; actual EE XY as real; meters, native rate, no smoothing.
nodes.reported_results: Mean error 1.5-3.8 cm; all five score TRUSTED under draft gates.
nodes.limitation: One task/session/embodiment and successes only; no independent simulator-policy transfer, contact force, full 6D pose or failure-distribution evidence. README says raw HDF5 retained but this extraction did not inspect them.

nodes.label: Synthetic cross-kinematic morph proxies
nodes.description: Replays droid_pour_s1 at 0.55x, 1.40x and 0.50x/1.00x aspect scaling.
nodes.status: synthetic proxy, not real multi-robot transfer
nodes.limitation: WidowX/RT-1 OXE pairs are planned, not supplied evidence; geometry rescaling does not execute a neural policy on a different embodiment.

nodes.label: vv-batch/1 governance samples
nodes.description: Episodes contain id, source, generation, sim and real. Samples: real alpha 0 GOVERNED; mixed 0.6 REVIEW; synth-heavy 0.9 BLOCKED/HIGH; generation ladder.
nodes.alpha_definition: Synthetic fraction in this MVP convention, opposite to Genesis alpha.
nodes.limitation: Batch source-count thresholds and generation curves are heuristic governance demonstrations, not measured model-collapse probabilities.

nodes.label: Dataset provenance admission policy
nodes.source_location: Provenance policy, How public real captures slot in, Regen
nodes.rationale: Require source, license, seed and documented transforms; validate cards and pairs before manifest admission.
nodes.limitation: Policy wording is not proof that every stored card complies; validate source URLs, licenses and transform records separately.

nodes.label: MVP evidence labels and knowledge-to-module map
nodes.description: Maps drift, Frechet, action sensitivity, spread, jerk and bounds to scorecards and ledger evidence; distinguishes live recomputation from external reports and draft estimates.
nodes.limitation: 'Verified' here means recomputed, not certified. Claims that a JSONL chain proves accumulate-not-replace or that spread supplies MTBF are unsupported; competitor and market assertions are not verified.

nodes.label: Prototype build and exit gates
nodes.source_location: Build graph and Node exit criteria 1-11
nodes.description: Fixed-fixture metrics, four deterministic policies, exact-zero playback response, ledger tamper rejection, local API smoke, worsening sweep and offline handoff.
nodes.limitation: 5/5 and server start below two seconds are document targets, not results verified in this extraction; monotone noise versus verdict is a fixture expectation, not a universal law.

nodes.label: Original scorecard REST contract
nodes.description: GET policies/compare/ledger/ledger-verify/governance/history; POST score(policy,seed), sweep(policy,from,to,steps), hunt(policy,budget), dossier(policy,seed).
nodes.limitation: Documented local fixture API, not a deployed live robot contract; GET compare is described as ledger-writing despite GET convention.
nodes.required_extension: Keep uploaded/offline evaluation separate from live telemetry ingestion and approved action interfaces; add schema versions, run/model identity, units, timestamps, error semantics, authorization and audit provenance.

nodes.label: Same-seed action intervention probe
nodes.description: Add a fixed offset to second-half actions and compare same-seed trajectories; normalized mean squared response replaces the old seed-shuffle proxy.
nodes.rationale: Measure response to a changed control input rather than random-seed sensitivity.
nodes.limitation: Requires callable or replayable policy interventions; one passive command/actual pair cannot establish counterfactual action sensitivity.

nodes.label: Fail-closed worst-gate verdict
nodes.description: Any red metric or unknown metric blocks; amber with no red requires review; all green produces the prototype TRUSTED label.
nodes.rationale: A favorable average must not conceal one critical failure.
nodes.limitation: A draft all-green verdict is not permission to deploy; distinguish missing evidence from measured pass.

nodes.label: Canonical-JSON SHA256 run ledger
nodes.description: Append-only JSONL entries link to the preceding hash; repeated scoring retains separate entries even with identical metric bytes.
nodes.limitation: Tamper evidence depends on a trusted retained root/checkpoint; an attacker able to rewrite an entire unanchored chain can rehash it. A run log does not enforce training-data accumulation.

nodes.label: Explicit original MVP exclusions
nodes.source_location: Section 9 Explicitly NOT in this MVP
nodes.description: No Isaac/Genesis physics simulator, real OXE data, authentication, database or frontend framework in the original plan.
nodes.limitation: Later corpus documentation adds DROID captures and upload workflows; retain this as an earlier scope boundary rather than declaring that no real data exists anywhere.

nodes.label: Compliance-page regulatory claims and badges
nodes.status: visible source assertions; external verification not performed
nodes.description: Claims Annex I Part A Item 24, blanket OTA reassessment/new CE marking, frozen-weight nuance, an ISO draft publication window and AI Act embedded-system dates.
nodes.limitation: Exact item numbering, affected categories, substantial-modification tests, timelines and assessor queues need authoritative checking; a green Verified badge is not legal evidence.

nodes.label: Draft compliance dossier evidence workflow
nodes.source_location: How this MVP bridges the gap, Working evidence, Calibration status
nodes.description: Buttons expose ledger verification, sample scorecard download and dossier generation; gates remain DRAFT until OXE calibration.
nodes.limitation: Same page calls the dossier compiler roadmap-only while offering Generate; HTML alone cannot resolve backend maturity, and generated records are not assessor-accepted certification.

nodes.label: frechet_sim_real metric
nodes.source_location: The 8 metrics in detail; row frechet_sim_real
nodes.description: Worst matched path separation using discrete Frechet distance.
nodes.limitation: Units follow trajectory coordinates; geometric matching is not time-aligned contact or full sim-to-real validation.

nodes.label: mean_drift metric
nodes.source_location: The 8 metrics in detail; row mean_drift
nodes.description: Average tracking error over the 200-step fixture.
nodes.limitation: Requires aligned samples and compatible coordinate frames/units.

nodes.label: final_drift metric
nodes.source_location: The 8 metrics in detail; row final_drift
nodes.description: Terminal tracking error; can expose late drift but miss earlier excursions.

nodes.label: coherence_horizon_ratio metric
nodes.source_location: The 8 metrics in detail; row coherence_horizon_ratio
nodes.description: Fraction of path before sustained drift breach; isolated spikes are debounced.
nodes.limitation: Three samples represent different physical durations at different sampling rates; the ratio is not a multi-hour stability guarantee.

nodes.label: action_sensitivity metric
nodes.source_location: How scoring works; The 8 metrics in detail; row action_sensitivity
nodes.description: Normalized response to a deliberate command intervention; zero indicates no response in the fixture.
nodes.limitation: Large response alone does not establish correct or safe response; passive trajectories lack the required intervention.

nodes.label: mean_spread metric
nodes.source_location: How scoring works; The 8 metrics in detail; row mean_spread
nodes.description: Variance across five seeded rollouts.
nodes.limitation: Squared coordinate units; cannot establish MTBF or calibrated uncertainty, and deterministic playback can have zero spread while failing.

nodes.label: max_jerk_proxy metric
nodes.source_location: The 8 metrics in detail; row max_jerk_proxy; Honesty labels
nodes.limitation: No contact-dynamics proof. Do not label it m/s^3 without verifying finite-difference definition, actual timestamps and dt normalization.

nodes.label: bound_violation_rate metric
nodes.source_location: The 8 metrics in detail; row bound_violation_rate; Honesty labels
nodes.description: Fraction of samples outside the configured workspace box.
nodes.limitation: A box check is neither collision checking nor a proof of reachable-set safety; bounds must match frame, units and robot geometry.

nodes.label: DRAFT gate calibration and deployment-label tension
nodes.source_location: Start here; Your 7 vectors; Verdicts, fail closed; Honesty labels
nodes.status: prototype labels, not calibrated deployment authority
nodes.description: Eight gate bands await OXE calibration; documentation calls formal proofs and runtime PINN roadmap, and cross-embodiment partial.
nodes.limitation: TRUSTED 'ship it' and REVIEW 'usable' wording overstates what draft proxy metrics establish. Synthfed stands in for a trained model; no actual training evidence is supplied.

nodes.label: Uploaded batch audit contract
nodes.description: JSON episodes with id, source, generation, sim and real; UI advertises 40 episodes and 3 MB limits; reports ratio, source drift and governance/collapse labels.
nodes.limitation: Limits and behavior are HTML claims, not server validation proven here; display example is shorthand, not valid example JSON.
nodes.required_extension: Validate schema, finite coordinates, lengths, explicit units/frame/time metadata and trustworthy provenance; report unavailable metrics rather than inventing values.

nodes.label: Shape-normalized cross-embodiment comparison
nodes.description: Compare two executed paths using shape-normalized Frechet; two real Franka episodes then real versus morph proxy.
nodes.limitation: Normalization may remove meaningful absolute-scale error; shape similarity is not kinematic feasibility or transferable policy success.

nodes.label: Recursive resampling collapse illustration
nodes.description: Successive resampling/refitting generations illustrate diversity loss.
nodes.limitation: Not a policy-training run, online collapse detector or evidence that a particular VLA has collapsed.

nodes.label: Evidence-first physical-AI console surface
nodes.source_location: Corpus strip, real-pair panel, upload panel, policy controls, result panel, governance panel
nodes.description: Real-pair selection, upload audit, fixture scoring, sweep/hunt, metric gates, path canvas, JSON export, ledger and run history; sidebar links Dashboard, Documentation, Compliance and Evidence.
nodes.limitation: HTML inspection establishes controls, not interaction correctness, visual precision or live hardware connectivity.
nodes.required_extension: For a precision-engineering console expose axes, units, frames, timing, uncertainty, gate version and evidence status; preserve run/source context without implying a hardware session exists.

nodes.label: Offline static scorecard backup

nodes.author: Adari Karthikeya

nodes.limitation: Lists research directions and partial maturity, not implemented platform coverage; 'errors multiply exponentially' is not the same bound as Genesis O(T epsilon).
